final_synthesis_description: Accept the boss's gesture graciously without hard insistence, preserving relational warmth and avoiding a power standoff; any reciprocity signal should use soft, non-committal language (e.g., 'Maybe I can treat next time') that conveys goodwill without creating a felt obligation or implicit contract.
remaining_disagreements: Exact wording and form of the reciprocity signal (firm offer vs. permission-based language vs. small immediate gesture)
How much agency the employee should visibly assert in the moment to protect personal integrity without creating awkwardness
Whether any immediate symbolic action (e.g., covering a small add-on) is preferable to a purely verbal future-reciprocity cue
